# spoke_buckets (Data Source)

Complete bounded discovery of buckets in the configured parent scope, using the provisional mock-v2 API. An incomplete or denied page fails the entire read; discovery never mutates services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use environment provider configuration for this parent collection.
# A denied or incomplete page fails the entire read.
data "spoke_buckets" "available" {}

output "buckets" {
  value = data.spoke_buckets.available.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Exact collection target path.
- `items` (Attributes List) Complete snapshot, ordered by opaque ID. An empty list is returned only after complete authorized discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
